_what: The corpus for the 2026-09-29 replication of the semantic-vs-lexical recall result. Self-contained: everything needed to re-run the measurement without the c5-recall-matcher branch.
_why: The handoff's caveat was 'one run, n=20, one model, labels I wrote'. This bundle exists so the next person re-runs it rather than trusting it.

_provenance.original_labels: committed at 8d1202f0 BEFORE the lexical matcher was first run against them; reproduced verbatim below
_provenance.paraphrases: authored by an agent shown ONLY the situation strings — never the 141 triggers, never the labels
_provenance.hard_negatives: authored by an agent told only to write dull, ordinary engineering moments; it never saw the corpus, the triggers or any other part of this experiment
_provenance.mixed_set: the 20 positives and 60 negatives shuffled under opaque Q-ids so kind cannot be inferred from the id

_the_falsifier: A forced-choice must-fire-only set CANNOT fail: an LLM always names something, so scoring only hits measures the labeller's taste. The 60 negatives are what make the number mean anything, and the pre-registered kill condition was >=8 false fires of 60.

original_labels._what: A LABELLED must-fire/must-be-silent set for the recall matcher, over PLAN-STEP situations.
original_labels._why: Written and committed BEFORE running the matcher against it. Every earlier number in this build was derived from output I looked at first: the 17% fire rate came from 30 commands I chose, and the 'B3 looks promising' claim came from reading 195 matches and noticing the good ones. Reading a list and noticing hits cannot count MISSES, because a miss is invisible without a label. Committing the answers first is the only way this set can falsify anything.
original_labels._method: Situations are drawn from real `Doing:` lines written during this project's sessions, or are realistic paraphrases of moments that actually occurred. Expected entries were chosen by reading the memory corpus's triggers, NOT by running the matcher. Where more than one entry is genuinely right, `expect_any` lists them and surfacing any one counts as a hit.
original_labels._scoring: hit = the expected entry appears in the top N. miss = it does not. violation = a `must_be_silent` situation surfaces anything at all.

semantic_run2_33._note: disagreed with run1 on 2 of 33, BOTH inside expect_any

semantic_probe_80._caveat: answer key was reachable in the same directory; superseded by the isolated run

semantic_isolated_80._note: clean room: input dir held only corpus+queries, output written elsewhere, agent reported opening only those files; agreed with probe_80 on 79/80

_bound: 0 false fires in 60 gives a 95% upper bound of 5.0% by the rule of three. That is the precision claim this experiment earns — no more.

mechanism_measurements_same_day._what: Three measurements taken to decide WHICH mechanism to build. Each retires an option.

lexical_recall_at_k._situations: the same 20 blind paraphrases, threshold floored to 0
lexical_recall_at_k._verdict: A lexical shortlist caps the mechanism at 60%. A shortlist can only LOSE recall. lexical+LLM scores at best 12/20 vs 20/20 for the LLM alone, so the no-new-dependency hybrid is REFUTED. Applies to LEXICAL shortlists only; embedding recall@k is unmeasured.
lexical_recall_at_k._corrected: 2026-09-30, round 1 M3: this held SEVEN ranks for a claimed eight (33 was missing), and re-deriving it showed the run used a 144-entry corpus while the rest of the experiment used the frozen 141. Eight fall below rank 10 in BOTH, so recall@10 = 12/20 and the 60% ceiling stand.

call_frequency._derived_from: plan files on disk, not estimated
call_frequency._verdict: Frequency is ~18x lower at plan granularity. Speed is not the binding constraint, so embeddings' advantage buys headroom with no use. High frequency is the MEASURED failure: 52.7% firing, 11.7% false fires.

model_call_latency.cli: claude -p, v2.1.281, authenticates from disk with no API key
model_call_latency._verdict: ~51x the old hook; 29 min/session at 275 invocations. Cannot be synchronous on a frequent boundary. Resolution is PRECOMPUTE at plan-arm time (begin-plan.py writes every step's Doing: line up front), one call per plan, hook becomes a dict lookup, fire-time latency zero.
model_call_latency._corrected: 2026-09-30, round 1 M5: 6.41s is a CLI start-up floor on a trivial haiku prompt, not this call. The real call is 16.1s, and 11.2s once the subprocess stopped inheriting repo hooks.

embedding_backend_availability.codex_auth: ChatGPT OAuth, not a platform key
embedding_backend_availability._verdict: Embeddings cost a new vendor key or ~2GB of local deps, against #191's portability constraint for harness work.

mechanism_measurements_same_day._decision: Build the LLM call, precomputed at plan-arm time. Defer embeddings to a MEASURED trigger: pad the corpus to 300/600/1000 and re-run the 80-item probe to find where discrimination degrades.
